rationale: This is the official Healenium deployment repository (github.com/healenium/healenium) containing Docker Compose files, shell installation scripts, and database schema for running Healenium self-healing proxy. It provides the orchestration layer for hlm-backend (Spring Boot), hlm-proxy (Java), and selector-imitator (Python) services. No application source code is present — only deployment/configuration artifacts. Tier B reflects: direct relevance to self-healing pipeline concern, published Docker images with versioned releases (hlm-backend:3.5.1, hlm-proxy:2.2.1), multi-mode deployment (Selenium Grid, Selenoid, Appium), and clear architectural documentation in README. Limited by: no source code in this repo (source lives in separate healenium-backend, healenium-proxy, healenium-selector-imitator repos), no test files, no architecture/design docs beyond README.
limitations: No application source code — this repo only contains deployment manifests and installation scripts
Source code distributed across separate repositories (healenium-backend, healenium-proxy, healenium-selector-imitator)
No unit/integration tests in this repository
No architecture design documents (ADRs, design specs) beyond README overview
Database schema is minimal (only schema creation, no table definitions visible)
Selector imitator Python source not included (cloned at install time)
